# Gulf Coast Palms

> Palm tree trimming, diamond cutting, trunk skinning, installation, removal and hurricane preparation across Northwest Florida's Emerald Coast.

Gulf Coast Palms LLC is a palm-tree specialist serving Northwest Florida. Licensed and insured, with general liability insurance and workers' compensation coverage on every job. 5.0 rating from 152 Google reviews (checked 2026-09-18).

## Contact

- Phone / text: (850) 910-1290
- Email: info@gulfcoastpalmservices.com
- Website: https://gulfcoastpalmservices.com
- Base: Navarre, FL
- Hours: Monday–Saturday; storm and emergency calls answered seven days a week

## Service area

Pensacola, Navarre, Gulf Breeze, Destin, Fort Walton Beach, Milton, Pace, 30A, Perdido Key, Niceville, Mary Esther, Santa Rosa Beach, Crestview, Perdido — Perdido Key to 30A.

## Services

- [Palm Tree Trimming](/services/palm-tree-trimming): Professional palm tree trimming for homes, HOAs & commercial properties across the Emerald Coast. Proper techniques for healthier, storm-ready palms.
- [Palm Tree Installation](/services/palm-tree-installation): Professional palm tree installation with 1-year warranty. We source, deliver, and hand-plant premium palms across the Florida Emerald Coast.
- [Palm Tree Removal](/services/palm-tree-removal): Safe, professional palm tree removal across the Emerald Coast. Licensed & insured crews with proper equipment for any size job.
- [Palm Diamond Cutting](/services/palm-diamond-cutting): Precision diamond cutting for palm trees. Resort-quality trunk patterns for homes, HOAs & commercial properties on the Emerald Coast.
- [Palm Tree Trunk Skinning](/services/palm-tree-trunk-skinning): Professional trunk skinning for a smooth, polished palm appearance. Eliminate pest habitats and enhance curb appeal across the Emerald Coast.

## What makes us different

- Palm specialists, not a generalist tree crew — trimming, diamond cutting and trunk skinning are core work, not add-ons.
- Free quotes from a texted photo: send a photo to (850) 910-1290 and we usually reply with a price the same day.
- Proper technique: we remove dead fronds, seed pods and flower stalks — never healthy green fronds or the crown.
- Full cleanup and haul-off included on every job, with before/after photos attached to the invoice.
- HOA, condo and commercial programs with volume pricing, board reporting and priority hurricane response.
